$comment: SLOP-28 (EXP-1259 D4/D5): THE search list x4, ONE component for every place that searches a list and picks from it: the `#` issue typeahead in every editor and composer, the composer '+' menu's Implement issue and Run action submenus (composer-menu.json), the issue Picker and the global issue search (web Cmd+K dialog, the IDE search, the phones' search tab). Low-level, so it is also the eUI catalog's `SearchList` (packages/exponential-ui, conformance + 4 renderers). Anatomy: an INPUT row (`input.height`, the nav-search glyph, the field, trailing the muted result COUNT once a query is typed) over the hairline, then the ROWS = the Picker rows (no new row type; issue rows = status glyph, mono identifier, title; action rows = icon + name), `row.height` px on a pointer, `row.heightPhone` on phones, the list scrolls with at most `maxVisibleRows` visible and a `fadeHeight` px bottom fade while more rows sit below; the top row is preselected, Up/Down move (no animation), Enter or Tab pick, a hover selects. Results = `useIssueSearchResults` (lib/issue-search.ts: local rank + the server splice) at the DEFAULT limit (ISSUE_SEARCH_DEFAULT_LIMIT): the editors' old 6/8 typeahead caps are gone. THE `#` TYPEAHEAD: typing `#` at the start of the text or after whitespace or `(` opens the list anchored at the caret (pointer: a popover `popoverWidth` wide; phones: a bottom sheet over the keyboard) with ITS input focused and prefilled with the token typed after the `#` (`typeaheadPrefill`), spaces allowed in the input; a pick replaces `#token` in the editor with `#IDENT ` and returns focus to the editor after it; Escape closes and returns focus leaving the editor text as typed; Backspace in an EMPTY input closes the list and deletes the `#` (deleting `#` closes it). The issue picker and the global search use the same component with their own input placeholder (ISSUE_SEARCH_PLACEHOLDER).

typeaheadPrefill.name: a bare hash opens with an empty input
the token after the hash prefills the input
an identifier token keeps its dash
a hash inside a word is not a trigger
whitespace between the hash and the caret ends the token
